items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Even Duke and Basie and all them, I mean they played for dancing.

ctx.x: One night we played in Mankato, Minnesota. Mankato Ballroom. And generally Stan would like spread out. But this night the bandstand was small. So we were like this. And the band started swinging. And of course we all wanted to swing. So the band was swinging and he stopped it. He said, “this is not Basie. This is Stan Kenton.” So we were looking at each other like damn. We finally got off the — you know—
